sentence: The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms—calls and templates for building (P01/P03/P04), upkeep and repair (P05), neighbourly treaties and help (P07/P08/P16/P17), attacks and tracing (P06/P09/P14), chat coordination (P23), jokes (P26), and recording, closing, and remaking (P10/P11/P12/P13/P24)—and the unused concepts in the sample show no organizing the model lacks or contradicts.
